old: 1 TB/month free egress per AWS account. Because it is a pull-through cache in front of an arbitrary origin, it can front a NON-AWS origin — so in principle it can serve the 150 GB Oracle block volume or any other free tier, absorbing 1 TB/month of a ~500 GB/day serving load. It stacks with Oracle's own 10 TB/month.
new: CloudFront can use any publicly accessible URL as its origin, so it can front a non-AWS origin, such as another provider's free tier, and serve cacheable responses from edge locations.

evidence.proved: the application behind CloudFront may be on any publicly accessible URL, not only on AWS
